steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "0" until Button A is pressed and released

2. When Button is pressed and released, clear screen

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "0" until Button A is pressed and released

2. When Button A is pressed and released, 
- Increase the number by 1 per second and display the number on the LCD Screen
- When the number reaches 59, the number will reset to 0 and continue to increase

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "0" until Button A is pressed and released

2. When Button A is pressed and released, 
- Increase the number by 1 per second and display the number on the LCD Screen
- When the number reaches 59, the number will reset to 0 and continue to increase

3. When the number is not paused and Button A is pressed
- The counter will stop increasing and display the number on the LCD Screen

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "0" until Button A is pressed and released

2. When Button A is pressed and released,
 - Increase the number by 1 per second and display the number on the LCD Screen
 - When the number reaches 59, the number will reset to 0 and continue to increase
 - The LCD will continue to display the running number until Button A is pressed.

3. When the number is not paused and Button A is pressed,
 - The number will stop increasing and display the number on the LCD Screen
 - The LCD will continue to display the number on the LCD Screen until Button A is pressed

4. When the number is paused and Button A is pressed, 
 -  Reset the number to 0 and display the number on the LCD Screen
 -  Perform step 2 requirements
